evidence.exact_quote: requirements_quality_report.json is the machine-readable requirements quality artifact, validates against pm.requirements_quality_report.schema.v1, and is verification-canonical but noncanonical for planning decisions.

items.impact: Implementations can disagree about who emits the artifact, when it becomes current, whether publication is atomic, and how invalid or stale reports are surfaced and recovered.
items.statement: POA-031 fixes the artifact's schema and decision authority but does not define its producer, generation trigger, currentness marker, atomic-write behavior, or failure and recovery states.
items.title: Requirements quality report lifecycle is underspecified

evidence.exact_quote: requirements_coverage.json validates against pm.requirements_coverage.schema.v1 and is generated by extracting authoritative requirement IDs from requirements.md into requirements[] with initial uncovered coverage state.

items.impact: Duplicate, malformed, case-variant, or repeated IDs and changing source order can produce incompatible coverage baselines while still appearing schema-valid.
items.statement: POA-032 establishes extraction and initial state but does not specify duplicate-ID handling, malformed-ID diagnostics, ordering, normalization prohibitions, or behavior when requirements.md cannot be parsed completely.
items.title: Requirement extraction lacks adversarial input rules

evidence.exact_quote: Node shard requirement_refs map known requirement IDs to node_ids[] and record unknown refs in orphaned_node_requirement_refs[] with the req_id_not_in_requirements_md sentinel.

items.impact: Repeated refs, duplicated node IDs, missing shards, or partially readable shard sets can yield unstable counts and orphan collections across implementations.
items.statement: POA-033 defines known and orphaned mapping outcomes but not deduplication, stable ordering, multiplicity, missing-shard handling, or whether partial shard reads invalidate the entire mapping.
items.title: Node requirement mapping lacks cardinality semantics

evidence.exact_quote: Acceptance manifest req_id fields map acceptance check IDs to known requirements while checks without req_id do not contribute and unknown req_id checks are ignored for uncovered_acceptance[] computation.

items.impact: A typo or stale requirement reference in an acceptance check can disappear from uncovered-acceptance computation without a required diagnostic, allowing false confidence in traceability quality.
items.statement: The deliberate exclusion of unknown req_id checks from uncovered_acceptance[] is clear, but POA-034 does not require those invalid references to be retained in a separate error collection or to fail verification.
items.title: Unknown acceptance requirement IDs can be silently masked

evidence.exact_quote: Coverage status is computed as covered, partially_covered, or uncovered from node and acceptance mappings, and uncovered_acceptance[] records only requirements with node coverage but no mapped acceptance checks.

items.impact: Node-only, acceptance-only, multi-node, and invalid-reference combinations can be classified differently, making summary counts and gates nonportable.
items.statement: POA-035 names three states and one uncovered-acceptance condition but does not provide a complete truth table for every node-mapping and acceptance-mapping combination.
items.title: Coverage states lack a falsifiable decision table

evidence.exact_quote: The requirements_coverage summary object is computed after all mapping steps and reports total, covered, partially covered, uncovered, orphaned_refs, and uncovered_acceptance_count values from the generated collections.

items.impact: Summary fields may be computed from different generations of underlying collections or survive a partial mapping failure, producing internally inconsistent but individually plausible values.
items.statement: POA-036 requires post-mapping computation but does not define a generation identity, atomic snapshot boundary, overflow behavior, or invalid-summary state when any mapping step fails.
items.title: Coverage summary has no atomic snapshot contract

evidence.exact_quote: requirements_coverage.md is regenerated deterministically from requirements_coverage.json and must match JSON counts and IDs exactly while listing covered, partially covered, uncovered, orphaned, and uncovered acceptance entries.

items.impact: Ordering, escaping, headings, newline convention, and rendering of unusual IDs may vary while counts and IDs still match, defeating byte-level reproducibility and migration stability.
items.statement: POA-037 requires deterministic regeneration and semantic parity but does not define the canonical ordering and serialization format needed to make determinism objectively testable.
items.title: Markdown determinism lacks canonical serialization

evidence.exact_quote: The verifier must enforce deterministic traceability integrity checks including summary count equality, uncovered and orphaned lengths, Markdown ID parity, and JSON schema validation.

items.impact: Callers cannot reliably distinguish stale input, schema failure, parity mismatch, incomplete generation, or tool failure, and may publish or retain invalid outputs.
items.statement: POA-038 lists integrity checks but omits stable failure codes, aggregation versus fail-fast behavior, currentness checks, publication blocking, and rollback or quarantine behavior for failed artifacts.
items.title: Traceability verifier lacks a failure and recovery protocol

evidence.exact_quote: Traceability outputs persist to seglog as requirements_quality_report, requirements_coverage_json, and requirements_coverage_md artifact types, with filesystem files regenerable from seglog.

items.impact: Regeneration can select the wrong version, expose superseded data, diverge under concurrent writes, or fail irrecoverably on corrupt or incomplete records.
items.statement: POA-039 makes seglog authoritative for regeneration but does not specify version selection, transactional boundaries, retention, access control, corruption detection, or recovery from partial persistence.
items.title: Seglog-backed regeneration lacks lifecycle guarantees

evidence.exact_quote: - "AI correctness, planning correctness, and validator correctness must not depend on quickstart.md."

items.impact: The convenience artifact cannot become an accidental hidden input to correctness-sensitive behavior.
items.statement: POA-040 explicitly and testably excludes quickstart.md from AI, planning, and validator correctness authority.
items.title: Quickstart authority is explicitly noncanonical

evidence.exact_quote: quickstart.md is generated deterministically from acceptance_manifest commands using manifest traversal order, fixed count and byte limits, verbatim command membership, and the exact truncation note.

items.impact: Different byte encodings, newline choices, long single commands, duplicate commands, or a truncation note that itself exceeds the limit can produce nonidentical outputs or invalid files.
items.statement: POA-041 fixes traversal order and limits but not the byte encoding, newline bytes, duplicate handling, command-boundary truncation, or precedence between the command count, file-size ceiling, and mandatory truncation note.
items.title: Quickstart generation is not fully deterministic at limits

evidence.exact_quote: If quickstart.md is present, validators enforce file size, executable command count, verbatim command membership in acceptance_manifest, and absence of commands not present in the manifest command set.

items.impact: A validator may misclassify prose, fenced blocks, multiline commands, shell continuations, comments, or injected Markdown as executable commands and either admit unmanifested execution or reject valid output.
items.statement: POA-042 requires command-set membership but does not define the quickstart grammar or the exact parser that determines executable command count and membership.
items.title: Quickstart validation lacks a command grammar

evidence.exact_quote: - "This changelog/source-lineage coverage must not override implementation-facing POA-002 through POA-042."

items.impact: Historical summary prose cannot supersede the fine-grained implementation-facing PlanUnits it describes.
items.statement: POA-043 provides an explicit non-override boundary between source-lineage coverage and implementation-facing authority.
items.title: Change-summary authority is correctly bounded

evidence.exact_quote: Runtime evidence projections remain downstream consumers of the storage-owned receipt packet.

items.impact: Downstream projections can disagree on packet identity, version, freshness, permission filtering, missing-receipt behavior, and whether projection failure can mutate storage-owned truth.
items.statement: POA-044 states the authority direction but supplies no receipt-packet identity, read interface, currentness rule, projection failure contract, or reciprocal contract reference.
items.title: Runtime evidence consumer seam lacks a concrete interface

evidence.exact_quote: Validation artifact lineage requires auditor_cycle_report, workflow_run_id, pass_verdict, phase_plan_ref, requirements_quality_report_ref, and any legacy validation_pass_report mirror to carry compatibility_only true plus cycle_report_ref; validation lineage stays concrete and inspectable, and report records remain upstream artifacts rather than local replacement identifiers.

items.impact: Dangling, cross-run, cyclic, stale, or contradictory lineage references can satisfy field presence while failing to prove the claimed validation history.
items.statement: POA-045 names required lineage fields and legacy mirror flags but does not define their schema types, referential integrity, run-scoping, uniqueness, cycle prevention, currentness, or disagreement handling.
items.title: Validation lineage fields lack integrity semantics

evidence.exact_quote: - FileManager open actions receive resolved target type and trust/freshness state, not only a path-like string.

items.impact: Permission revocation, stale identity, unavailable generated objects, corrupt previews, route changes, or a time-of-check/time-of-use race can open the wrong target or present a misleading successful state.
items.statement: POA-046 specifies the resolved inputs FileManager must receive but not resolver authority, permission revalidation, freshness thresholds, target transition states, offline behavior, race protection, or recoverable error outcomes.
items.title: Open-by-identity lacks a secure resolution state machine

evidence.exact_quote: Project_Output_Artifacts owns packaged output references for plans-to-code receipt families: PlanCompile receipt, ExecutorIntakeReport, worknode_dispatch_receipt, source_control_receipt, source_control_preflight_receipt, safe_point_receipt, worknode_change_receipt, test_run_receipt, auditor_cycle_report, auditor_verification_receipt, repair_attempt_receipt, legacy validation_pass_report compatibility mirrors, merge_or_promotion_receipt, worknode_completion_receipt, source-control finalization receipt, model resolution receipt, and GoalCompletionReceipt. Artifact records preserve source artifact, destination artifact, owner, validator, receipt, schema payload, retry route, rollback route, user escalation condition, evidence refs, changed artifacts, test artifacts, source-control refs, model receipts, Auditor cycle refs, and final certification status without becoming the runtime source of truth.

items.impact: Consumers cannot know which fields are required for each receipt family, how absent or partial child receipts are represented, or what sensitive evidence may be packaged, retained, redacted, and retried.
items.statement: POA-047 enumerates many receipt families and a superset of preserved fields but does not bind each family to a versioned schema, required-field matrix, lifecycle, redaction policy, or partial-packaging behavior.
items.title: Plans-to-code receipt families lack per-family contracts

evidence.exact_quote: GoalCompletionReceipt package entries must prove all_worknodes_terminal, all_tests_passed_or_dispositioned, source_control_receipts_valid, no_active_blockers, rollback and safe-point requirements satisfied, Auditor passed, no stale Plan/WorkGraph/currentness mismatch, final source state clean or intentionally preserved, final summary/evidence written, and final certifier decision. The receipt links to child receipts, WorkNode receipts, changed artifacts, validator outcomes, authority checks, evidence refs, unresolved risks, source-control receipts, test receipts, model resolution receipts, source evidence, canonical Plan evidence, process evidence, governance evidence, test evidence, source-control evidence, completion receipts, and final source-control context refs.

items.impact: A completion receipt can be assembled from mutually stale evidence, accept undefined dispositions, race with new blockers or source changes, or be signed by an unspecified authority, creating false terminal completion.
items.statement: POA-048 lists strong completion predicates but does not define their exact boolean oracles, allowed disposition authority, a shared evidence snapshot/currentness token, final certifier identity, revocation semantics, or behavior when state changes during certification.
items.title: Goal completion proof can race and certify stale state

evidence.exact_quote: canonical_text: 'Approval creates an immutable, versioned Approved PRD Pack containing the primary PRD, accepted PRD-ledger snapshot, source manifest, traceability, assumptions and constraints, open questions, quality report, approval receipt, hashes, and version identity. PRD Builder preserves original uploaded artifacts byte-for-byte with stable source IDs, hashes, MIME/type metadata, and extraction status before semantic processing. Create deterministic text, heading, page, table, image, and offset projections plus a source manifest recording coverage, extraction warnings, skipped content, and parser versions. Planning topics may accept uploaded reference images and generate wireframes, architecture diagrams, data-flow diagrams, state diagrams, or visual references through the existing image system, with artifact IDs, provenance, topic links, version, and status. Online capability research records source URL or provider reference,

items.impact: Immutable packs, byte-preserved uploads, parser projections, generated media, research provenance, receipts, and ApprovedPlanPack can each be implemented with incompatible integrity, retention, privacy, failure, and scale behavior while the broad PlanUnit appears satisfied.
items.statement: POA-049 combines several independently stateful artifact families but supplies only generic preservation criteria, not per-family schemas, owners, lifecycle transitions, privacy and deletion rules, size limits, failure recovery, or executable acceptance oracles.
items.title: Planning pack artifact families are not independently testable

evidence.exact_quote: gui_related: false
canonical_text: History export supports selected-row export, multi-select bundle export, and whole current filtered-view

items.impact: GUI planning and validation can omit selection state, active-filter disclosure, export progress and cancellation, redaction-profile choice, accessible feedback, and partial-failure presentation for a user-visible export capability.
items.statement: POA-051 defines user-triggered selected-row, multi-select, and filtered-view export behavior yet marks gui_related false, creating a direct mismatch between capability truth and GUI coverage metadata.
items.title: History export is incorrectly classified as non-GUI

segments.summary: Reviewed all eight traceability PlanUnits and their semantic units. The authority boundaries are generally clear, but deterministic extraction, mapping, summary, serialization, verification, and failure-state semantics are not complete enough for interoperable implementation.

Reviewed seglog persistence, quickstart generation and validation, lineage authority, and runtime evidence projection boundaries. Two non-authority constraints are explicit; persistence, parser, limit-edge, and cross-document consumer contracts remain underspecified.

Reviewed validation lineage, artifact open-by-identity, receipt packaging, and goal completion certification. The excerpt names strong fields and boundaries, but secure resolution, per-family schemas, referential integrity, atomic currentness, and certifier authority require closure.

Reviewed planning-pack and history-export artifact contracts. The planning pack unit is too broad for per-family falsifiability, while history export is user-visible behavior incorrectly marked non-GUI.

Which authority defines GoalCompletionReceipt snapshot currentness, disposition approval, certifier identity, revocation, and recertification?
Which GUI owner specifies History export selection state, active-filter disclosure, redaction-profile choice, progress, cancellation, accessibility, and partial failures?
